items.title: UNCONDITIONAL GRATITUDE
items.quote: I will thank [You] Hashem with all my heart.
items.text: Your gratitude for Hashem’s mercy should not be dependent on His doing more kindnesses in the future.

items.title: SO MANY THINGS
items.quote: I will proclaim all of Your wondrous deeds.
items.text: Have in mind all the other occasions when you were helped and all the daily miracles you experience.

items.title: SHARE YOUR KNOWLEDGE
items.quote: I will proclaim all of Your wondrous deeds.
items.text: Share your experiences and your knowledge of Him with others.

items.title: NO INTERMEDIARY
items.quote: I will rejoice and exult in You.
items.text: Strengthen your relationship with Hashem by realizing that it was He who helped you and not any apparent intermediary.
“I will sing praise to Your Name, Most High.” Inspire others through song
items.title: SING IN PRAISE

items.w: בשוב אויבי אחור יכשלו ויאבדו מפניך
items.title: POWER IN WAR
items.quote: When my enemies retreat, they stumble and perish from Your presence.
items.text: Hashem instills fear in the hearts of the enemy.

items.title: MY CAUSE
items.quote: You carried out my judgment and my cause.
items.text: I did not even have to fight my enemy for You took up my cause.

items.title: RIGHTEOUS JUDGE
items.quote: You sat on [Your] throne, O righteous Judge.
items.text: You determine if the righteous person is worthy of a miracle being done on his behalf. But all men are judged based on the rule of law.

items.title: VENGEFUL JUDGE
items.quote: You rebuked peoples and You doomed the rasha.
items.text: You execute strict judgment agains the wicked.

items.w: ויהוה לעולם ישב כונן למשפט כסאו
items.title: ETERNAL JUDGE
items.quote: Hashem is enthroned forever. He has established His throne for justice.
items.text: The past and future are always before Him.

items.w: והוא ישפט תבל בצדק ידין לאמים במישרים
items.quote: He judges the world with righteousness. He judges the nations in fairness.

items.title: DEFENDER OF THE WEAK
items.quote: Hashem will be a tower of strength for the downtrodden.
items.text: He defends Yisrael and if Yisrael is victimized by evil people, He comes to their aid and avenges them.

items.title: NAME OF HASHEM
items.quote: Those who know Your Name will trust in You.
items.text: Through His Name you are assured of His continuity throughout eternity, which means He is able to keep His promise. See also, Mizmor 005.

items.title: FAITHFUL TO HIS PEOPLE
items.quote: You do not forsake those who seek You.
items.text: Those who turn to Hashem in tefillah are assured of His response.

items.w: כי דרש דמים אותם זכר לא שכח צעקת ענוים
items.quote: For He Who avenges the blood of the many peoples that were victimized by oppressors has remembered them.
